title: Add smooth UI transitions and move Report an Issue button to bottom of Home page

requirements.text: Add smooth, consistent graphic transitions for route/page changes across the app so navigating between pages feels animated (e.g., fade/slide in), while respecting accessibility (disable/limit animations when the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled).
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating between routes (e.g., Home -> Browse Rooms -> Room Detail) shows a smooth transition animation rather than an abrupt content swap.
Animations are suppressed or significantly reduced when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
No changes are made to immutable hook files; transitions are implemented in editable layout/routing components and/or global CSS utilities.

requirements.text: Move the existing “Report an Issue” trigger on the Home page to the bottom of the Home page content (visually near the end of the page, above the global footer), keeping the same dialog behavior and English label text.

quotes: report an issue button should be in bottom of homepage

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, the “Report an Issue” button is placed at the bottom of the page content (not in the hero section).
Clicking the button still opens the existing ReportIssueDialog and submitting still works as before.
The button remains visible and properly styled in both light and dark themes without overlapping the site-wide footer.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend architecture remains single-actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Do not change issue reporting data fields, storage format, or admin issue/notification behavior.
Do not redesign the overall theme beyond what is needed to implement smoother transitions and reposition the button.
